L300->L400 best AbsRel improves0.00186860 but CI crosses0; RMSE/delta1 also cross0. F1 rises0.02335407 with positive CI, while bandAbsRel worsens0.00617424 with positive CI. No monotone across-metric sample-size benefit.
L300-R300 best AbsRel -0.00416288 and RMSE/delta1 CIs cross0; F1 -0.01640164 with negative CI, bandAbsRel -0.00977939 with negative CI. One seed does not establish a universal winner.

Final-best AbsRel rises1.01955%; its CI and other depth/band CIs cross0. F1 falls0.03881201 with CI[-0.05113809,-0.02845288]. 166/218images loseF1,43gain,9tie; predicted edges433484->389630, matchedGT284976->258134,zero-pred-edge images7->11; GT edge total769528 unchanged.

Final L300-L200 F1 is higher with positive CI because L200 has its own severe endpoint degradation; this must not be confused with L300 beating the L200 best checkpoint. Against R300 final,L300 F1 is worse and bandAbsRel better with CIs excluding0.

training_review: Raw best1100,stop2000 by patience,stableNULL. Significant-improvement anchor at1000: the rawbest1100 improves only0.1247%, below0.2%, so no patience reset. Target0.10 starts100 and confirms300;0.09 not reached.

After the sharp initial gain, validation plateaus around0.092-0.095 while training loss continues down (best-step0.04020 to final0.03656). This is an overfitting/plateau signal, not explosive divergence. Final just exceeds1% abovebest; terminal500-step stability criterion is not satisfied.

2000attempts,1997successfulupdates,16000exposures,53.333effectiveepochs; AMP skips105/110/932, none afterbest. No evidence attributing later edge degradation to an AMP skip, architecture component or file error.

integrated_interpretation: More fitting data improves mean metric-depth error in this matched seed, but not every scene or boundary measure. LoRA300 first-seed gains concern depth values; the best checkpoint already loses some discontinuity detection versusB0/L200, and stopping further weakens thin structures. Keep best/final and positive/negative visual cases separate; wait for allthree seeds for group conclusions.
